title: Quadratic prefix recurrence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a Boolean sequence of length $n$, and let $k<n$. The quadratic value of the prefix of length $k+1$ equals the quadratic value of the prefix of length $k$ plus, in $\mathbb F_2$, the product of the linear sum of the first $k$ mapped coordinates and the mapped value of $w_k$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean sequence indexed by $0,\ldots,n-1$
